findings.message: Since PHP 7.0, functions inspecting arguments, like debug_backtrace(), no longer report the original value as passed to a parameter, but will instead provide the current value. The parameter "$item" was changed on line 873. (PHP 7.0 behaviour: func_get_args() and similar report the current value of a changed parameter, and code that runs on PHP 7 or 8 today already gets this, so the upgrade changes nothing)

Method name "ACFE_AutoSync_Json::__return_false" is discouraged; PHP has reserved all method names with a double underscore prefix for future use. (method names starting with __ are only discouraged; nothing changes on newer PHP)
